articles.title: SpaceX Dragon to Deliver Wooden Bones and Bacterial Spies to the ISS
articles.summary: A SpaceX Dragon is set to launch with 6,500 pounds of cargo, including an experiment that grows bone cells on a wooden scaffold and another that tests if Earth-based microgravity simulators are accurate. The mission also carries a particle detector to improve space weather forecasts.

articles.title: A Termite's Worst Molt-Day: New Chemical Blocks Exoskeleton Growth, Spares Humans
articles.summary: UC Riverside researchers found that bistrifluron, a chitin synthesis inhibitor, kills 95% of drywood termites by preventing them from forming a new exoskeleton during molting. Because it targets chitin—absent in mammals—it poses no toxicity risk to humans, offering a safer alternative to fumigation.

articles.title: Medicare's $50 Weight Loss Drug Pilot: A Bridge to Nowhere?
articles.summary: Starting July 2026, Medicare's GLP-1 Bridge program will offer weight loss drugs like Wegovy for a $50 copay, but only for 18 months. The copay doesn't count toward the Part D out-of-pocket cap, and the program's end could leave users facing regained weight and high costs.
